name: Royal Backup & Reset
author: WP Royal

sections.description: Royal Backup & Reset is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that provides complete backup, restore, and reset functionality for your WordPress website. Whether you need to create regular backups or reset your database, this plugin has you covered.To create your first backup, navigate to the main plugin menu. Under the Create Backup tab, you will find the Start Backup Process button. Click on the button, and after a few seconds, your first backup will be created. To restore your backup, please navigate to the Restore Site section where you will find all your backups. Click on the Restore button to start the restoration process. If you want to reset the database and start from a fresh WordPress installation, navigate to the Database Reset section. Select the checkboxes based on your needs and click on the Perform Database Reset button. Please note: all your data will be deleted, and there is no way to restore it if you do not have a backup. So, we strongly recommend backing up your site before resetting it.
sections.faq:
Can I schedule automatic backups?

Currently, the plugin supports manual backups. Automatic scheduling features may be added in future versions.
